question: Which of the following date is observed as a national festival?
solution:
The correct answer is __**2 October**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The date observed as a national festival in India is 2 October
 
• 2 October is celebrated as Gandhi Jayanti, marking the birth anniversary of Mahatma Gandhi, the Father of the Nation.
 
• It is a national holiday and is observed as a day of non-violence and peace in India.
 
• This date is also observed as the International Day of Non-Violence globall
